---
title: "Scaffolding"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_scaffolding               <- file.path(currentdir, "05_scaffolding")
outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref    <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "01_union_to_ref")
outdir_scaffolding_haptounion    <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "02_hap_to_union")
outdir_haptounion_virlike        <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_haptounion, "virlike")
outdir_haptounion_declike        <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_haptounion, "declike")
outdir_scaffolding_binning       <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "03_binning")
outdir_scaffolding_visualisation <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "04_visualisation")

sapply(c(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, outdir_haptounion_virlike, outdir_haptounion_declike, outdir_scaffolding_binning, outdir_scaffolding_visualisation), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# check if scaffolding reference genome exists
if (!file.exists(params$scaffold_reference)) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Scaffolding reference genomes is not found. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}

# check if scaffolding metadata file exists
if (!file.exists(params$scaffold_chr_map)) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Scaffolding metadata file is not found. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

```{r ref-update}
# open the metadata file
df_scaffold_metadata <- data.table::fread(params$scaffold_chr_map)

# extract the respective chromosomes and update the names
seq <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(params$scaffold_reference)
seq <- seq[names(seq) %in% df_scaffold_metadata$old_id]
names(seq) <- sapply(names(seq), function(x) { df_scaffold_metadata$new_id[df_scaffold_metadata$old_id==x] })

# save the updated reference genome
fn_scaffold_ref <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$scaffold_reference)), ".fna"))
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq, filepath=fn_scaffold_ref)
```

```{union-to-ref}
# combine the two haplotypes
fn_dedup_union <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, "union.dedup.fa")
system(paste("cat", fn_hap1_dedup, fn_hap2_dedup, ">", fn_dedup_union))

# run RagTag
f_ragtag(fn_ref            = fn_scaffold_ref,
         fn_query          = fn_dedup_union,
         ragtag_parameters = "--mm2-params '-x asm20' -f 25000 -u -a 0.2",
         dir_out           = outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref,
         thread            = params$thread,
         exe_ragtag        = params$exe_ragtag)

# extract the respective chromosomes
system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "grep -r -p '^Chr'", file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, "ragtag.scaffold.fasta"), ">", file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, "union_chr.fa")))
```
